change_control.downstream_binding: Every downstream cross-contract analysis, display, claim map, manuscript, and supplementary package must record this contract path, schema version, and SHA-256 digest.
change_control.revision_rule: A semantic change requires an approved follow-up ticket, a schema or contract revision, and revalidation of every downstream artifact bound to the predecessor digest.

permitted: Compare operational measurability and bounded gap events under the local Gaussian and native ViPErLEED measurement contracts.
Report agreement, disagreement, recovery, and physical self-consistency with explicit fixed or outcome-specific denominators.
Classify an accepted continuation as branch-model disagreement, cross-contract target inconsistency, or unresolved only when the frozen native contract and positional tolerance support that label.
State that observability or a failure interpretation is measurement-contract dependent when principal-scan results support that conclusion.
Describe the contribution as a cross-contract, denominator-aware assessment of measurement-chain failure semantics.
prohibited: Treat either measurement contract as absolute position ground truth or spot-identity ground truth.
Use unqualified identity-switch, false-persistence, physical-disappearance, or physical-visibility claims for a contract-defined outcome.
Call a Gaussian-contract gap an I(V) visibility gap without independent evidence allowed by the frozen claim boundary.
Treat successive frames, branches from one scan, or the two contracts applied to the same acquisition as independent experimental replicates.
Present the restricted pilot as independent confirmation after it has calibrated the native contract.
Claim invention of LEED spot tracking, radial scaling, aperture measurement, or gap bridging.
required_qualifiers: Contract-defined states are operational outcomes of their complete analysis pathways, not intrinsic labels attached to an image.
Cross-contract target inconsistency is evidence of disagreement with an indexed native target, not proof of a ground-truth identity switch.
Measurement-chain robustness and physical self-consistency do not establish instrument-traceable absolute accuracy.
All claims remain within the acquisition-closed, existing-acquisition-only evidence boundary.

effort_end_state.status_guard: Completing this ticket set does not by itself assert content-revision-complete, scientific-baseline-complete, or submission-ready; each canonical status still requires its own repository gates.

evidence_hierarchy.role: Frozen branch-frame outcomes from both principal scans under the local Gaussian and native ViPErLEED contracts, retaining every predefined opportunity.
Gap, recovery, agreement, physical-consistency, and target-inconsistency outcomes derived from rank-1 records with explicit nesting and denominators.
Limited predeclared sensitivity to native significance and cross-contract positional tolerance; it tests claim stability and must not optimize a method ranking.
Restricted pilot evidence used to freeze native parameters, beam mapping, and positional tolerance; it is calibration evidence, not an independent confirmation set.
Selected image crops and descriptive diagnostics used only to explain a frozen outcome; they do not determine quantitative labels or headline claims.

measurement_contracts.endpoint: A finite Gaussian-refined spot position that passes all frozen local acceptance gates.
measurement_contracts.role: Local TrackLEED ROI and two-dimensional Gaussian measurement pathway.

measurement_contracts.endpoint: A finite native raw beam-position deviation paired with significance meeting the predeclared native threshold.
measurement_contracts.role: Indexed, aperture- and whole-pattern-based ViPErLEED pathway whose native outputs are not passed through the TrackLEED Gaussian estimator.

operational_vocabulary.definition: For a predeclared branch-frame opportunity, the local TrackLEED Gaussian measurement returns a finite Gaussian-refined spot position and passes every frozen local acceptance gate.
operational_vocabulary.not_equivalent_to: physical visibility, native tracker success, or absolute position accuracy

operational_vocabulary.definition: For the indexed ViPErLEED beam mapped to a predeclared branch-frame opportunity, native significance meets the frozen threshold and both raw position deviations are finite; smoothed, extrapolated, or final coordinates alone do not qualify.
operational_vocabulary.not_equivalent_to: physical visibility, spot-identity ground truth, or a Gaussian-refined measurement

operational_vocabulary.definition: A maximal contiguous run of G=0 opportunities for one predeclared branch within one scan, bounded on both sides by G=1 for that branch.
operational_vocabulary.not_equivalent_to: physical disappearance or a confirmed I(V) visibility gap

operational_vocabulary.definition: A maximal contiguous run of V=0 opportunities for one indexed ViPErLEED beam within one scan, bounded on both sides by V=1 for that same beam.
operational_vocabulary.not_equivalent_to: physical disappearance or an estimator-independent visibility gap

operational_vocabulary.definition: An accepted Gaussian-path continuation and a direct native observation of its mapped indexed beam disagree by more than the frozen cross-contract positional tolerance after the declared coordinate alignment.

A retained opportunity or event for which the available contract states cannot support branch-model disagreement or cross-contract target inconsistency, including absence of a required direct native observation.
operational_vocabulary.not_equivalent_to: failure, neither-observed, or permission to remove the opportunity from a denominator

research_question: Do LEED spot measurability, gap recovery, and physical consistency remain stable across a local Gaussian measurement contract and a native whole-pattern ViPErLEED contract?

scope.comparison_unit: Predeclared branch-frame opportunities nested within scan, branch, and gap event; successive frames are not independent experimental replicates.
